unverified: Untagged local streets are assumed 25 mph (Maine's default in built-up areas, 29-A §2074); a few rural roads at the town's west edge may be posted higher.
Smithwheel Road and Portland Avenue (north of Milliken Mills Rd) have no MaineDOT speed regulation on file; they're shown at the 25 mph built-up default. Check the signs.
